The system boundary of the upstream natural gas supply chain begins at natural gas extraction and goes through transmission, which is consistent with the assumption that natural gas is being delivered to a large-scale end user. The U.S. average techno-basin mix is used in the U.S. average scenario, and the Midwest delivery region techno-basin mix is used in the Midwest scenario. Natural gas techno- basins are the combination of formation types, which dictate extraction technologies, and the geographic natural gas basin. These techno-basin mixes represent a weighted average of natural gas wells and extraction methods based on production volumes.
